verdict.rationale: The product's own docs show the skills are plain `SKILL.md` markdown files in ordinary folders. You can copy them into a repo's `.claude/skills/`, or paste any single SKILL.md into a chat outside Claude Code, where it runs as a mode. That covers readable, copyable, cross-harness portability with no proprietary format. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the skills work in non-Claude harnesses (the evidence is vendor docs only).

support.subject: As a developer, skills are plain markdown files and folders I can read, copy, and carry to another harness — not a proprietary binary format

citations.quote: No Claude Code at all? Paste any single `SKILL.md` at the top of a chat and it runs as a mode.
Project-local instead of global: copy the same folders into your repo's `.claude/skills/`.
Six of them, all standard-library Python. None touch the network.
